title: 26 The Pirate Ship Ride · 海盗船上少了一个人

sents.t: A group of friends are at a fair, riding the pirate ship ride, when one of them captures something disturbing on camera.
sents.zh: 一群朋友在游乐会上坐海盗船，其中一人用镜头拍到了让人不安的东西。

sents.t: The person who caught this writes, "Before coming to this fair, I've heard stories of a woman who had tragically died after falling off from one of the rides here.
sents.zh: 拍到这段的人写道：“来这个游乐会之前，我听说过一个女人从这里的游乐设施上摔下来、不幸身亡的故事。

sents.t: But that was many years ago.
sents.zh: 但那是很多年前的事了。

sents.t: This video was taken in 2008, at around 10 PM."
sents.zh: 这段视频拍摄于 2008 年，大约晚上 10 点。”

sents.t: Be sure to pay close attention to the background, or you'll miss it.
sents.zh: 一定要仔细看背景，不然就错过了。

sents.t: At first, there are four people sitting next to each other, but then a few seconds later, there's one less person.
sents.zh: 一开始有四个人并排坐着，但几秒钟后，少了一个人。

sents.t: It appears that the passenger on the left has disappeared.
sents.zh: 看起来左边的那位乘客消失了。

sents.t: The man recording this has no idea as to who she is, and still doesn't know to this day.
sents.zh: 拍摄的人完全不知道她是谁，直到今天也不知道。

sents.t: However, he can't help but think that this might have been the woman who had tragically died at this fair many years ago.
sents.zh: 不过，他忍不住觉得，这可能就是多年前在这个游乐会上不幸身亡的那个女人。

sents.t: Viewers think so too, and have even pointed out that her face looks injured in a couple of frames.
sents.zh: 观众也这么认为，甚至指出在几帧画面里，她的脸看起来是受伤的。

sents.t: But of course, what do you think?
Was a ghost caught on camera, or was this all just an illusion?
sents.zh: 是镜头拍到了鬼，还是这一切只是错觉？

sents.t: As always, feel free to let me know what you think.
sents.zh: 和往常一样，欢迎告诉我你的看法。
